Chicken Macro third-party materials

Collected package notices are retained verbatim. Some packages are build tools,
not necessarily runtime components. No claim that this inventory is exhaustive.
Tcl/Tk 9.0.4 notices and GNU GPLv3/LGPLv3 texts downloaded from upstream.
Exact pynput 1.8.2 source archive included; hash checked against PyPI metadata.
Third-party components keep their own licenses. Chicken resale restrictions
do not apply to the libraries independently.

This folder alone is not proof of license compliance. Review application
license exceptions, source/rebuild instructions and bundled components before release.
